comment: Provisional. Ratios from 3 runs on 2026-11-16, load average 200 to 229 on a shared 512-core machine: keyed yuka/solid 1.058, 1.144 and 1.152 (the last from make bench-gate); ssr yuka-stream/solid-node 1.389, 1.603 and 1.368; LCP page/plain HTML 1.04 to 1.64; TBT 0 ms on every page. The server-reason-react limit is from bench/ssr/README.md (1.76 after ticket 31), since it is out of the build. max_js_raw is the exact raw bytes of JavaScript files and inline scripts of each page: change it with the change that changes the bytes. Set again on 5349ba5: pull requests 27, 28 and 30 grew / and /my to 200,388 B and /issue/YUK-1 to 170,568 B without a change here, and pull request 26 then moved the router code out of the start chunk. Raised by 830 B on each page for issue 11: the scheduler walks a chain of memos with a loop. Raised by 199 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 for Action.start, the abort of a query Action.call when its owner is disposed, and a form answer that arrives after its form is gone. Raised by 141 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 for the demo issue overlay: c21860e (close on a click outside, Close button in the page header) added 157 B without a change here, and 0dbb27d removed 16 B. SSR solid-node limit set to 1.0 (the v1 target, SSR faster than Solid) from 20 main CI runs on ubuntu-latest, 2026-11-16. The rounds of one run agree: per-round yuka-stream/solid-node ratios differ by 4.4% or less in a run. The runs do not: the ratio groups by runner, seen in the absolute req/s of solid-node. Solid near 3,800 to 4,250 req/s: 8 runs, 1.229 to 1.268. Near 5,250 to 5,550: 7 runs, 1.202 to 1.262. Near 6,700 to 7,000: 3 runs, 1.062, 1.104 and 1.122 (5ca0734, 6d21a08, 3f156ec; 6d21a08 changes only docs after f6a3ce7 at 1.252). Near 7,100 to 7,300: 2 runs, 1.283 and 1.313. Both servers use one thread, so the groups come from the runner CPU type; more or paired rounds do not change them (paired-round medians move each run by 0.025 or less). With 1.0 all 20 runs pass and the worst keeps a margin of 5.9%. The Yuka slowdown that fails a run is 5.9% to 10.8% on the slowest group and 16.8% to 23.9% on the others: replayed on the 20 runs, a 10% slowdown fails 2 and a 20% slowdown fails 11. A tighter limit needs a limit per CPU: run.ts records the CPU model in the result and the log, so collect it first. Raised for compiled-view step 1 (each child and attribute of an HTML tag that is not a constant is a hole): / and /my by 74 B, /issue/YUK-1 by 79 B. The bytes are calls of functions of other modules in the markup, which are now holes: the hrefs from Links, Theme.label and the Model.Issue labels. Raised by 5 B on / and /my and lowered by 4 B on /issue/YUK-1 for Remote.state and Live.state: each Remote.make and Live.make keeps a memo of the status with the optimistic changes applied, made in one helper of Optimistic for both. Raised by 88 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 for the runtime part of the static-hole drop: an effect, hole or attribute hole whose first run reads no State is not kept by its owner, unless it adds a bubbling event handler, whose owner must be disposed with its parent. The JavaScript heap of /w/stress (2,000 rows) goes from 14.60 to 11.86 MB (11.16 MB before every non-constant JSX expression was a hole; 11.17 MB when a handler did not keep its owner). The server part (no markers for such a hole) was not kept: it cost 543 B more on / and /my, 487 B more on /issue/YUK-1 and 0.23 MB more heap on /w/stress, for 30 fewer comment nodes on /insights. Raised by 203 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 for State.select: a read of a memo first updates a selector whose source changed, so a memo over is_selected is up to date in a batch. Raised by 468 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 and by 242 B on /about for the demo Settings page: the head script restores four more settings (242 B inline on every page), and the Settings routes and link add 226 B to the JavaScript files. Raised by 205 B on / and /my and by 303 B on /issue/YUK-1 for two fixes to the Settings page: the keyboard shortcuts of the issue list and the sidebar are off while an overlay is open, and the theme menu and the Settings page show one shared State of the theme. Raised by 5 B on / and /my and lowered by 4 B on /issue/YUK-1 for Remote.state and Live.state: each Remote.make and Live.make keeps a memo of the status with the optimistic changes applied, made in one helper of Optimistic for both. The JavaScript heap of /w/stress (2,000 rows) goes from 14.60 to 11.86 MB (11.16 MB before every non-constant JSX expression was a hole; 11.17 MB when a handler did not keep its owner). The server part (no markers for such a hole) was not kept: it cost 543 B more on / and /my, 487 B more on /issue/YUK-1 and 0.23 MB more heap on /w/stress, for 30 fewer comment nodes on /insights. Raised by 203 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 for State.select: a read of a memo first updates a selector whose source changed, so a memo over is_selected is up to date in a batch. Raised by 5 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 for the router click listener on window, so that the prevent_default of an island stops the navigation. Raised by 194 B on / and /my and lowered by 319 B on /issue/YUK-1 for the delay search field of the demo issue routes: the generated Routes code reads and writes it (194 B in the JavaScript files of each page), and /issue/YUK-1 without the field no longer streams, so it has no fill script (513 B less inline). Raised by 434 B on / and /my and by 441 B on /issue/YUK-1 for Await ~blocking: Yuka.Await.make takes six arguments, so Melange calls it through Curry._6, which no other code of these pages used. Raised by 5 B on /, /my and /issue/YUK-1 because the router listens for link clicks on window, after the click handlers of islands on document. Raised by 46 B on / and /my and by 767 B on /issue/YUK-1 for Browser.stream and the failed view of a pending Await when a stream breaks: 46 B for the State in the start chunk (43 B on /issue/YUK-1), and 724 B for the inline fill script, which removes the failed view of each fill and shows the failed views left at DOMContentLoaded. Raised by 472 B on / and /my, and to the measured 163,425 B on /issue/YUK-1, for the scroll positions in sessionStorage (decision D9): the start code writes the positions on pagehide and reads them at start. Set to the measured 196,065 B on / and /my and 165,847 B on /issue/YUK-1 for the merge of nav2-next (Browser.prefetch, data-yuka-pending, GET form navigation, Await ~blocking, Browser.stream) into nav-next (Browser.block, its check on Back and Forward, the scroll positions in sessionStorage). Set to the measured 196,949 B on / and /my, 165,576 B on /issue/YUK-1 and 676 B on /about for the merge of main (Settings page, ?delay, router click listener on window) into nav-next: the window listener is on both sides and counts once, and /issue/YUK-1 without ?delay does not stream on a first load, so the 724 B that nav-next added to the inline fill script are not on that page. Raised by 11,092 B on / and /my and by 4,076 B on /issue/YUK-1 for pull request 69: the demo Select dropdown, a listbox with keyboard navigation and type-ahead in place of the native select of the status and priority pickers, and the scroll positions saved and restored on the nearest scrolling ancestor of the outlet in place of the window. Raised by 480 B on / and /my and by 431 B on /issue/YUK-1 for Server.config ~base: the browser reads the base once per document and puts it on the action, CSRF and live URLs, the generated href calls Router.url, and client navigation takes only links under the base. Set to the measured 197,730 B on / and /my, 166,312 B on /issue/YUK-1 and 676 B on /about for the merge of main (nav-next) into demo-entry (Server.config ~base): main gave 196,949 B and 165,576 B; the base adds 480 B and 431 B as before, less 3 B on / and /my and plus 1 B on /issue/YUK-1 when the two sides are bundled together (measured on the merge without the next change: 197,426 B and 166,008 B); and 304 B on each page for the base check of Browser.navigate, Browser.prefetch and the GET form navigation in the start code: a URL outside the base is a full page load and is not prefetched. Set to the measured 208,843 B on / and /my and 170,386 B on /issue/YUK-1 for the merge of main (pull request 69, the demo Select dropdown) into demo-entry: main gave 208,041 B and 169,652 B, and the base adds 802 B and 734 B, against 781 B and 736 B before this merge. Set to the measured 208,943 B on / and /my and 170,497 B on /issue/YUK-1 for pull request 71: the scroll restoration goes back to auto on pagehide, and to manual in save_scroll and on a pageshow from the back/forward cache (100 B and 111 B).
